spots.name: The Palmetum

bio_facts.fact: Palm-only botanical garden in Douglas, main entrance University Road, opened 1988 as a Bicentennial project
About 300 species across all six palm subfamilies, about 60 Australian natives, many rare in the wild

spots.name: Billabong Sanctuary

bio_facts.fact: 11-hectare wildlife sanctuary in Nome, 17 km south of Townsville
Daily crocodile feeding, hand-feeding kangaroos, koala photos, reptile show, wombat and meerkat experiences; ZAA accredited

cost.note: koala photo from $25 is an extra

spots.name: Wallaman Falls

bio_facts.fact: Cascade and horsetail waterfall on Stony Creek in Girringun National Park, Wet Tropics World Heritage area; main drop 268 m, the country's tallest single-drop waterfall; pool 20 m deep; about 100,000 visitors a year
Day-use area with lookout and toilets; Bangurru camping area nearby (paid, booked online)

sources: search summaries of https://parks.qld.gov.au/parks/girringun-wallaman: no day-use fee stated
cost.note: camping fee applies only to the campground; Queensland has no state park pass in parkPasses.ts
